extract_notes: Axon's FY2021 10-K is a state/local law-enforcement + SaaS narrative. NO named Pentagon Program Elements (PE numbers) are disclosed, NO named DoD Programs of Record are cited as revenue drivers, NO customer >10% of net sales, no IDIQ ceilings, no Program-of-Record (POR) deliverables, no specific DoD line items. The strongest DoD-adjacent language is generic: 'U.S. federal civilian and defense agencies' as a customer market, and an aspirational mention of 'U.S. federal government and military' as a market we are investing sales personnel into. This means the J-Book divergence pattern (named PE -> J-Book status) is STRUCTURALLY INAPPLICABLE for AXON: the company makes no specific Pentagon program claims for the framework to verify. The expected score profile is therefore dominated by UNVERIFIABLE (no specific PE/program named) plus PASS on control claims (patents/facilities/counterparty/federal-presence). This is itself a useful negative observation: it confirms the framework correctly identifies that AXON is NOT a J-Book-dependent issuer.

claims.claim_text: Axon sells to 'U.S. federal civilian and defense agencies' as one of its customer markets.
claims.subject: Axon Enterprise, Inc.
claims.object_value: U.S. federal civilian and defense agencies
claims.source_quote: Who we sell to - State and local law enforcement, U.S. federal civilian and defense agencies, justice and court systems, corrections, fire departments and emergency medical services providers, consumers, and commercial enterprises such as private security firms and transportation providers

claims.claim_text: Axon is 'investing in sales personnel to capture new markets, including the U.S. federal government and military' as a forward growth vector.
claims.subject: Axon Enterprise, Inc.
claims.source_quote: In recent years, we have been investing in sales personnel to capture new markets, including the U.S. federal government and military, departments of corrections, the fire and emergency medical services markets, and new geographies outside the U.S.

claims.claim_text: No customer (including any DoD customer) represented more than 10% of total net sales in 2021, 2020, or 2019.
claims.subject: Axon Enterprise, Inc.
claims.object_value: no customer >10% of total net sales
claims.source_quote: No customer represented more than 10% of total net sales for the years ended December 31, 2021, 2020 or 2019. Our primary customer market is U.S. law enforcement.

claims.claim_text: Axon derives a significant portion of revenue from sales of TASER conducted-energy-device (CED) products (TASER 7, X26P, X2, etc.); these are commercial CEDs sold primarily to police, not Pentagon programs of record.
claims.subject: Axon Enterprise, Inc.
claims.object_value: TASER CEDs (commercial police product, not a J-Book PE)
claims.source_quote: In the years ended December 31, 2021, 2020 and 2019, we derived a significant portion of our revenue from sales of our TASER CEDs ... We substantially depend on sales of our TASER CEDs

claims.claim_text: Axon's Software & Sensors segment depends on Axon Body 3 / Axon Fleet body and in-car cameras plus the Axon Evidence (Evidence.com) cloud SaaS subscription — none of which are tied to a named DoD program of record.
claims.subject: Axon Enterprise, Inc.
claims.object_value: Axon Body 3, Axon Fleet, Axon Evidence cloud SaaS
claims.source_quote: Software and Sensors segment ... sales of sensors, including on-officer body cameras, Axon Fleet cameras, other hardware sensors, warranties on sensors, and other products ... Axon Cloud revenue

claims.claim_text: Axon names NO specific Pentagon Program Element (PE) number, Program of Record, or named DoD line item (e.g., Skyborg, CCA, SDA Tracking Layer, Project Maven, Short Range Reconnaissance, etc.) anywhere in its FY2021 10-K as a revenue driver, pipeline item, or backlog component.
claims.subject: Axon Enterprise, Inc.
claims.object_value: no named PE / POR in 10-K narrative
claims.source_quote: [absence-of-evidence — verified by exhaustive grep of the 120K-char slice for PE numbers (pattern \d{7}[A-Z]), program names (Skyborg, CCA, Maven, SDA, Valkyrie, BQM-167, Quantum Networking, etc.), and program-of-record language]

claims.claim_text: Axon holds patent protection in 'certain key areas' of its CED, Axon device, and SaaS technology.
claims.subject: Axon Enterprise, Inc.
claims.object_value: patent estate in CED / device / SaaS technology
claims.source_quote: While we have some patent protection in certain key areas of our CED, Axon device and SaaS technology, new technology may result in competing products that operate outside our patents

claims.claim_text: Axon's corporate headquarters and manufacturing facilities are in an approximately 100,000-square-foot facility in Scottsdale, Arizona that the company owns.
claims.subject: Axon Enterprise, Inc.
claims.object_value: 100,000 sq ft owned facility in Scottsdale, AZ
claims.source_quote: Our corporate headquarters and manufacturing facilities are based in an approximately 100,000 square foot facility in Scottsdale, Arizona, which we own.
